name: issue_severity
input_text: Current photo of a warehouse rack bay, plus the issue already detected for this bay as JSON.
instructions: How urgently does the detected issue in this bay need staff action?

levels.label: none
levels.description: No real issue; the detection was a false alarm or purely cosmetic.

levels.label: minor
levels.description: Worth fixing at the next routine check; no impact on picking today.

levels.label: act_today
levels.description: Will affect picking or stock accuracy today; create a task for this shift.

levels.label: act_now
levels.description: Picking is blocked or there is a safety risk (falling load, blocked aisle); act immediately.
